data.title: Handwoven Manipuri Tribal Textile & Shawl
data.description: Authentic handwoven tribal textile fabric featuring traditional Manipuri geometric motifs, rich natural dyes, and exquisite loin loom craftsmanship.
data.craftStory: Handloom weaving is deeply rooted in Manipuri culture, woven with devotion on traditional loin looms. Each geometric pattern and border motif narrates sacred tribal folklore and generational resilience.

data.title: Manipuri Bamboo Bottle & Haversack Baskets
data.description: Traditional handcrafted bamboo water bottle container, haversack carrier, and open conical utility baskets. Made by indigenous artisans with seasoned golden bamboo.
data.craftStory: Bamboo bottles and haversack baskets are an eco-friendly marvel perfected over centuries in Manipur's hill tracts, allowing travelers and farmers to carry water and goods naturally.
data.dimensions: Haversack: 16 x 10 inches, Bottle: 10 x 3.5 inches

data.title: Maring & Monsang Bamboo Fishing Baskets
data.description: Authentic indigenous Maring and Monsang tribal bamboo fishing traps and storage baskets, intricately hand-plaited for wetland and river fishing across Manipur.
data.craftStory: The Maring and Monsang tribes are revered for their ingenious bamboo trap weaving. Designed specifically for Loktak Lake and hill streams, these baskets combine hydrodynamics with beautiful aesthetic symmetry.
data.dimensions: Maring Basket: 14 x 11 inches, Monsang Basket: 13 x 9 inches

data.title: Manipuri Kouna Grass Handwoven Picnic Basket
data.description: Handcrafted from indigenous Manipuri water reed (Kouna), this eco-friendly picnic and carrier basket features strong braided handles, durable lock loops, and natural moisture-resistant finish.
data.craftStory: Kouna is an indigenous swamp wetland reed unique to the valleys of Manipur. Artisans harvest, sun-dry, and weave the spongy stems into flexible, shock-absorbent, and biodegradable lifestyle wares.

data.title: Manipuri Handcrafted Cane & Bamboo Tableware Tray Set
data.description: Set of traditional Manipuri woven bamboo trays, winnowing platters (Yangkok style), and serving bowls handcrafted with seasoned hill bamboo and fine cane splints.
data.craftStory: Bamboo craft in Manipur embodies circular harmony with nature. These trays are woven by master craftsmen using indigenous spiral and twill interlacing methods suited for modern dining and home decor.
data.dimensions: Platter: 14 inch dia, Bowl: 7 inch dia, Tray: 12 inch dia

data.title: Traditional Floral Embroidered Manipuri Inaphi Shawl
data.description: Exquisite rose-pink Manipuri Inaphi wrap woven with sheer delicacy on fly-shuttle and loin looms, decorated with vibrant multi-colored hand-embroidered floral motifs and temple borders.
data.craftStory: Wangkhei Phee and Inaphi are legendary textiles of Manipur, historically woven for royalty. Each floral vine is painstakingly embroidered with fine needlecraft on lightweight gossamer cotton-silk warp.

data.title: Handwoven Manipuri Mapan Naibi Phanek (Pink)
data.description: Traditional handwoven Manipuri ethnic Mapan Naibi Phanek featuring signature horizontal striping in pink and black, paired with intricately hand-embroidered circular motif border.
data.craftStory: Mapan Naibi is the esteemed traditional attire worn by Meitei women on festivals and ceremonies. The border design is an ode to ancient royal motifs, woven on frame looms with exquisite precision.

data.title: Sohrai Painting - Harvest Festival
data.description: Traditional Sohrai wall painting on canvas depicting the harvest festival celebration. Hand-painted by master artist using natural pigments.
data.craftStory: This artwork follows the centuries-old Sohrai tradition, originally painted on mud walls during harvest festivals. Each symbol represents aspects of nature worship and agricultural prosperity.

data.title: Dokra Elephant Figurine
data.description: Handcrafted brass elephant using the ancient lost-wax Dokra technique. A symbol of wisdom and good fortune.
data.craftStory: Dokra is a 4000-year-old metalworking tradition. Each piece is unique as the clay mold is broken to reveal the brass artwork inside.

data.title: Tussar Silk Saree - Natural Dyed
data.description: Luxurious Tussar silk saree with traditional tribal motifs. Naturally dyed using plant-based colors.
data.craftStory: This handwoven silk celebrates Manipur's rich textile heritage. The golden luster and natural dyes give every piece a distinctive local character.

data.title: Bamboo Craft Storage Basket
data.description: Intricately woven bamboo basket with tribal patterns. Functional art piece for storage or decoration.
data.craftStory: Bamboo weaving is a traditional skill passed down through generations of Manipuri families. Each basket takes 2-3 days to complete.

data.title: Khovar Art Wall Hanging
data.description: Traditional Khovar wedding art rendered on handmade paper. Features sacred marriage symbols.
data.craftStory: Khovar art is traditionally created on the walls of wedding chambers. The geometric patterns symbolize fertility and marital bliss.

data.title: Stone Carved Tribal Deity
data.description: Hand-carved stone sculpture of a Sarna deity. Traditional tribal religious art.
data.craftStory: Sarna worship is central to tribal spirituality. This sculpture represents the deity of the sacred grove, carved from local granite.

data.title: Tribal Terracotta Pot Set
data.description: Set of 3 hand-molded terracotta pots with traditional tribal designs. Perfect for plants or decoration.
data.craftStory: The Kumhar community has been making pottery for generations. Each pot is fired in traditional kilns and decorated with natural colors.

data.title: Handwoven Tribal Shawl
data.description: Warm woolen shawl with traditional tribal motifs. Handwoven on traditional looms.
data.craftStory: This shawl is woven using techniques passed down through generations. The geometric patterns tell stories of tribal mythology.

data.title: Lac Bangle Set
data.description: Set of 6 colorful lac bangles with traditional tribal designs. Handcrafted using ancient techniques.
data.craftStory: Lac bangles are a traditional adornment in tribal marriages. The intricate patterns are created using heated lac and skilled hands.

data.title: Tribal Musical Drum - Mandar
data.description: Traditional Mandar drum used in Santhali folk music. Handcrafted with authentic materials.
data.craftStory: The Mandar is central to Santhali celebrations and rituals. This drum is made using traditional methods and local materials.
